LAKOTLNG 1: First Year Lakota First Quarter is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Focus on speaking writing and listening while developing communicative skills in Lakota. Interactive approach emphasizing the ability to express concepts related to daily activities within traditional Lakota cultural contexts.
LAKOTLNG 2: Continuation of LAKOTLNG 1. First Year Lakota Second Quarter is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Focus on speaking writing and listening while further developing communicative skills in Lakota Interactive approach emphasizing the ability to express concepts related to daily activities within traditional. Prerequisite LAKOTLNG 1 or placement test.
LAKOTLNG 3: Continuation of LAKOTLNG 2. First Year Lakota Third Quarter is the third course in a three quarter sequence.Focus on speaking writing and listening while further developing communicative skills in Lakota Interactive approach emphasizing the ability to express concepts related to daily activities within traditional. Prerequisite: LAKOTLNG 2 or placement test. Fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
LAKOTLNG 21: Continuation of LAKOTLNG 3. Focus on speaking writing and listening while developing students' communicative skills in Lakota. Interactive approach emphasizing the ability to express concepts on a variety of social and cultural topics within traditional Lakota cultural contexts. Prerequisite: LAKOTLNG 3 or placement test.
LAKOTLNG 22: Continuation of LAKOTLNG 21. Focus on speaking writing and listening while developing students' communicative skills in Lakota. Interactive approach emphasizing the ability to express concepts on a variety of social and cultural topics within traditional Lakota cultural contexts. Prerequisite: LAKOTLNG 21 or placement test.
LAKOTLNG 23: Continuation of LAKOTLNG 22. Focus on displaying an increased ability in reinforcing and expanding the scope of communication in Lakota, including all skills. Emphasis on engagement in a wide range of context-specific and culturally appropriate interactions in Lakota. Prerequisite: LAKOTLNG 22 or placement test.
LAKOTLNG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
